status: the Windward Deep: the chamber and its levels. The buildings are town content and come after.
region: the_deep, traced from the owner's annotated heightmap (data/rift_regions.json)
why_y0: The owner, 2026-09-22, having flown the whole Rift: it should sit very low in the ground, not at y40. Measured at (3603, 3222): surface y83, build floor y-64, bedrock at the bottom. y0 leaves 83 blocks of cover and 64 below for the shell.

form.why: At 83 blocks down the Deep cannot be a terraced pan open to the Rift's sky: there is unbroken ground above it. It is a chamber, and the city stands in levels inside it, which is what 'almost a futuristic city fuelled by the Rift' asks for. The Displaced City cavern is the precedent for the rock shell.

roof.why: Tallest over the middle and closing down to the walls, so it reads as a chamber. min_cover is the rock that must remain between the roof and the surface: the carve is clamped per column so it can never break through.

shell.why: Any void within 4 blocks of the carve becomes rock, so the chamber never opens into a cave, an aquifer or the Rift's own floor.

level_why: Three decks 16 apart, sized to the chamber: its deepest point is 109 blocks from the wall, so insets of 5, 38 and 72 give about 103k, 50k and 13k columns. The floor keeps a 5-block margin of bare rock at the walls, so the chamber reads as rock the city was built inside rather than as a paved box. A 16-block riser is not walkable on purpose: the city moves between decks by lift, which is what makes it read as built rather than as terrain. LumyMon has an `elevator` block; the lifts themselves are town content.

deck.why: Rechiseled is dressed masonry, which is wrong for a torn cliff and exactly right for a built city. Its connecting variants stop a large deck reading as a grid.

light.why: The Rift fuels the city: the same violet the veins use, set into the decks on a loose grid. Light 15, and it conditions no spawn.

spawn_policy: No block placed here may condition a spawn (data/spawn_blocks.json). The chamber is unlit rock and dressed stone; the glow is the galar particle block, which is clean.

tunnel_mouth.why: Where Victory Road leaves the Deep. The tunnel itself is a separate pass and needs the League's final position; this only opens and marks its mouth so the chamber is not sealed.
